thread_analysis.thread_summary: Companion thread to thread_0201 — both cover the same Premium Audio Company (Onkyo GX10 Powered Speaker) registration project. This thread captures the start and early execution phase (Jan 28 – Feb 13, 2025): customer submits payment confirmation, Allion begins registration proxy, encounters a cloud document sharing access issue (link restricted to named user 'yukihiro.nakano' and not accessible to Allion), customer re-shares with correct permissions, Allion downloads the registration confirmation document and performs the registration, sends Review Page for customer confirmation, customer approves, Allion confirms the registration, requests Compliance Folder documents, customer sends four product documents, and Allion ships the CD-R. Also includes a reminder about free derivative product addition via Manage Submitted Products for future products with the same module and Host Stack.
all_questions_found: Cloud document sharing link is restricted to a specific named user — how to resolve?
What documents are needed for the Compliance Folder after registration?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The thread is operationally routine — the cloud link permission issue is the only notable process hiccup. The four required Compliance Folder documents are: (1) operation manual (Bluetooth section), (2) block diagram, (3) outline drawing, (4) antenna datasheet with radiation gain characteristics. The registration referenced two QDIDs for the Onkyo GX10 Powered Speaker.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Cloud document links must be shared with Allion's specific email address, not restricted to a named internal account. This is a routine process step that should be communicated upfront when requesting customer documents.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Document access issues delay registration start. If the DID has an expiration date, delays compound the risk.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None. Allion correctly identified the access issue and requested the customer to update sharing permissions.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: This thread is a companion to thread_0201. When sending document request instructions to customers, always specify that cloud links must be shared with Allion's email address and not restricted to a named user account.
